name: cmu-re-no-pandora
author: CMU-Revised
description: Turns off Pandora: its service (blm_ira_pandora) and backend (irs_server) do not start at boot, and MMUI no longer loads its screen module. Uninstall and restart to get the stock behaviour back.

files.reason: Pandora service and its backend off at boot; they never reset the board
Pandora service and its backend off at boot; they never reset the board
MMUI no longer loads the screen module(s) of this service, which it loads one by one before it answers the GUI
